entities.summary: Simphiwe Dana (b. 1980-01-23, Butterworth, Eastern Cape) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Butterworth, Eastern Cape and South Africa. Known in the fields of south africa, composers & musicians, africa.
